description: One-time ERC-20 approval of a token to the Permit2 contract, needed before paying x402 "upto" endpoints with that token. A normal on-chain transaction (needs gas). Pass amount to grant a bounded allowance; with no amount it asks for the maximum, which is refused by default, under AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_TOKEN, and always under a spend policy (where the allowance counts against the budgets). Only the operator can allow a maximum approval, with AGENTWALLET_ALLOW_UNLIMITED_APPROVAL=1 while no policy is set. Permit2 itself only moves what each signed authorization allows.

amount.description: Allowance to grant in human units (e.g. "100"). Omit for unlimited.

token.description: ERC-20 token address (e.g. USDC on Base)

name: approve_permit2
